rationale: Fresh lime anchors the Gimlet; caraway supplies aroma. The cordial made ahead for someone gives Gracious its place.
Unpeated blended Scotch keeps the grain character; hops add a beer-like accent and soda brings bubbles. Curious fits the experimental lineage.
A hot whiskey-and-honey cup carries the scent of briefly steeped thyme. Comforting describes the welcoming gesture of someone making it for you.
Blackcurrant and basil meet dry sparkling wine. Graceful evokes the gently built glass and the person who changes a room quietly.
Cooked ginger, cumin, lime and soda make an aromatic long drink. Playful belongs to the well-timed humour around its story.
Passion-fruit syrup rounds a Scotch cocktail with bitters and lemon oil. Devoted comes from the small, attentive addition to a familiar order.
Orange amer and sweet orange-peel syrup keep bitter and sweet together; soda adds sparkle. Radiant carries that orange brightness and the hopeful reading.
Gin, lemon and soda keep the Collins bright; jaggery adds darker sugar notes. Feisty evokes the purposeful sugar swap and speaking up.
Hot coffee and Irish whiskey sit under toasted-oat cream. Generous evokes the hospitality of the drink rather than its portion size.
Rum remains perceptible in a long, still grog; lime and sherry vinegar provide tang. Sociable fits a measured drink made to let the evening last.
Old Tom gin, sweet vermouth and bitters make a rounded Martinez-like drink. Assured fits the considered choice of an older gin style.
Gin and a little Fernet give herbal depth; vermouth and stirring give smoothness. Intimate comes from fitting the measure to one person.
Aromatic bitters form the core, balanced by lemon and lemongrass syrup. Adventurous reflects the open spirit slot and deliberate experiment.
Cream and egg white build the cloudlike fizz; orange flower water supplies a floral accent. Dreamy belongs to both the glass and the Visionary's imagination.
Blanco tequila, lime and blue-agave syrup make a stripped-back Margarita. Effortless describes the finished impression, despite the care behind it.
Tomato-vanilla syrup tastes of ripe red fruit first, brightened by rum and lime, with a slight savoury undertone. Mischievous evokes its strawberry-daiquiri expectation being gently overturned.
Absinthe's anise and bitter herbs meet cranberry syrup and cold water. The changing louche earns Mesmerising; Silky refers to the diluted anise-oil texture.
Tamarind, lime and tea remain after milk clarification gives the rum punch a soft body. Enchanting evokes its overnight transformation.
Citrus and cranberry stay deliberately tart, with basil as a green accent. Liberating comes from the invitation to enjoy your own taste openly.
Violet liqueur scents the gin-and-lemon sour, with maraschino beneath it. Nostalgic evokes keeping an ordinary moment as it was.
Cognac, orange and lemon give the Sidecar spine; honey rounds it and a dash of olive brine seasons it. Commanding reflects the deliberate composition.
Rye and aromatic bitters carry warm spice; green Chartreuse adds herbs in the seasoning slot. Refined evokes revisiting an old drink through one considered change.
Blanco tequila and blanc vermouth meet just a teaspoon of peach liqueur. Delicate describes the small fruit accent and the restraint of leaving flowers alone.
A frozen Margarita base gains vanilla beside the orange, with fresh lime added for serving. Inventive comes from solving the freezing and dilution in advance.
Deep-amber caramel syrup seasons a single-barrel bourbon Old-Fashioned with bitters. Intrepid evokes being first to step forward.
White rum, blanc vermouth, Madeira and orange curaçao give layered fruit and mellow wine depth. Wonderstruck evokes noticing something worth pausing for.
Malty ale and aged rum meet darkened sugar in a hot flip without egg. Eccentric fits the elaborate route to the toasted-sugar flavour.
Blackberry liqueur arrives first over gin and lemon, with balsamic in the drizzle. Nostalgic belongs to the scent-led return to a remembered place.
Campari and two vermouths keep bitter and sweet level, with bay leaf in the gin build. Enigmatic evokes recognising something before explaining it.
Bacon-washed bourbon brings smoke beside maple; dry sparkling cider lengthens it. Audacious fits making an unconventional drink by doing the work yourself.
Mezcal meets grapefruit, lime, honey and sparkling water. Adventurous reflects bringing a place's taste home to share.
Rich plum syrup adds fruit to a blended-malt Scotch Old-Fashioned with aromatic bitters. Steadfast comes from keeping the way back in mind.
Three rums, lime and grapefruit meet cinnamon, clove and anise accents. Spellbinding evokes the Zombie's intricate construction, with its coded mix made legible.
Equal measures of rye and sweet vermouth are lengthened with soda and finished with bitters. Generous reflects sharing the weight rather than a large serve.
Bourbon meets fresh lemon, orange and pomegranate, with seltzer and mint. Optimistic belongs to the bright, long drink and the patiently made argument.
Stone-pine liqueur, rum and allspice make a hot, aromatic cup. Adventurous evokes choosing the next route after an achievement.
Cold beef broth and sherry give a vodka long drink savoury depth, with orange lifting it. Intriguing fits a less familiar steakhouse drink discovered through practice.
Aged Jamaican rum, lime and curaçao meet toasted-almond orgeat and a big mint branch. Exuberant reflects the storytelling around a lime-forward Mai Tai.
A Vesper-like gin-and-vodka drink is bone-dry and lemon-scented, with a small Jamaican-rum addition. Dashing fits the decisive, neatly delivered order.
Clear crème de cacao supplies chocolate beneath rum, vermouth and lime. Unexpected evokes a quiet-looking drink with a flavour you would not see coming.
Rye meets dark sorghum sweetness and digestif bitters. Roguish belongs to the grin and the dependable action behind an unreliable promise.
Cherry liqueur and lime make the gin-and-Bénédictine build fruity; soda and bitters finish it. Heartening reflects practical help with no fuss.
Tea-steeped cognac carries orange curaçao, aromatic bitters and a lemon-peel collar. Resolute evokes keeping a considered form when circumstances fray.
Rum, lime and sugar make a crushed-ice Daiquiri bowl; makrut leaves add lime scent. Ingenious fits solving the drink with what is available.
Fino sherry supplies dry, yeasty and subtly salty depth; chamomile honey gives body beside two vermouths. Gentle reflects the small, attentive sweetening.
Young red wine and cola make the fruity, bubbly Kalimotxo; matching frozen cubes preserve it. Carefree evokes handing over something made for the pleasure of it.
Cognac and white Pineau bring grape fruitiness and oak; Sichuan peppercorn adds a faint lip tingle. Curious belongs to the delighted second question.
Mango syrup brightens a juniper-spirit sour with fresh lime. Sunny reflects its open fruit character and the unshowy pleasure of getting better.
Lemon, Aperol and Amaro Nonino meet bourbon, with salt rounding bitter edges. Joyful fits the bright balance and the spontaneous laugh.
Jamaican rum and vermouth meet dark orange amaro and a generous orange peel. Devoted reflects affection delivered openly rather than in hints.
A long, still whisky drink pairs Tasmanian malt with a small Scotch addition. Light describes the water-lengthened serve; Hopeful belongs to the reading's possibility.
Aged rum meets sharp, still farmhouse cider and raw apple. Rustic evokes the orchard-like simplicity of the Stone Fence, with no promise of fizz.
Rum, lemon oils, lemon juice and black tea build a shared punch. Convivial comes from the bowl and the care taken the night before.
A measured gin Martini with a proper tablespoon of dry vermouth and lemon peel. Elegant evokes enjoying the ordinary classic without making it austere.
Bourbon and lemon are sweetened with sugar ground into the squeezed peel. Candid fits the small, useful truth offered kindly.
Orange peel and cracked coriander scent a gin-and-vermouth drink with red aromatic bitters. Upbeat belongs to making a grey occasion good anyway.
Scotch and Irish whiskey meet lemon and almond orgeat; coffee beans sit on top. Quirky reflects taking a small absurdity one step further.
Rye and aged rum are sweetened with demerara and aromatic bitters, then revealed by cracked ice. Impish comes from the deliberate play in the service.
Mezcal, whole egg and milk make a creamy flip; a little mezcal is served separately in the shell. Roguish evokes the joke beside the generous glass.
Rum and lime stay fresh under a tangerine-scented absinthe accent and bitters. Carefree evokes stepping outside the expected routine.
Cognac and kirsch meet coffee, cinnamon and cloves, poured through a citrus spiral. Alluring belongs to the slowly revealed, aromatic service.
Apple brandy and dry vermouth are sweetened lightly and topped with soda. Impish reflects the small prepared trick that makes the room more fun.
Banana liqueur brings the Jamaican rum's fruit character into the open; measured water softens the spirit. Outspoken fits saying the thing plainly.
Apricot-steeped rye is served beside crisp pilsner. Convivial describes the two-glass encounter; the fruit and malt come from different parts of it.
Rye, lime and sparkling mineral water make an unsweetened Rickey. Deadpan evokes the quiet delivery; Dry means there is no added sugar.
Bourbon and dry vermouth gain just enough pear syrup to balance them. Wry fits a dry-seeming drink with a little sweetness left in it.
Roasted apple, brandy, sugar and water make a soft, cooled fruit drink. Welcoming belongs to the preparation done before the guest arrives.
Four fresh citrus juices lead a gin drink sweetened with mint syrup. Inspiring evokes encouraging something another person is still making.
Tomato, dry sherry, lemon and celery salt give a vodka drink savoury bite. Daring fits the guest's readiness to say yes to a different pleasure.
Red wine carries the fruit beside rye, demerara and bitters. Gallant evokes going out of your way; no citrus juice or sour structure is implied.
Whisky and whole egg make a rich, silky flip with a faint lavender scent absorbed through the shell. Tender fits the openly affectionate reading.
Jasmine-tea syrup makes its flowers literal beside gin, lemon and a little Campari. Flirtatious comes from the half-joking invitation around it.
Gin, shochu and blanc vermouth are stirred with shiso and strained clear. Alluring evokes the quiet depth behind an easy first conversation.
Beetroot-steeped sweet vermouth adds earthy sweetness beneath rye and curaçao. Tempting comes from the invitation to leave the polite evening together.
Bourbon, lemon and honey make a direct Gold Rush. Lovable reflects the unshowy care of a familiar, dependable drink.
Pineapple and pomegranate meet strong white rum and fresh lime, with thyme in the syrup. Seductive evokes the deliberate, vivid construction.
Bourbon and rich syrup sit under a large mint bouquet on pounded ice. Romantic belongs to the Julep's ode and the remembered detail offered back.
Sweet and dry Spanish anise spirits turn hazy when shaken; aromatic bitters add spice. Enchanting reflects the quiet work that makes someone else's night.
Gin and vodka meet lemon, rosemary syrup and soda, with orange seasoning. Generous evokes making more of a request than the guest expected.
Light grain whisky, blanc vermouth and a teaspoon of calvados make a rounded stirred drink. Intriguing reflects a small adjustment that reveals another possibility.
Young Folle Blanche Armagnac adds flowers beside cognac; green-gooseberry syrup supplies the tang. Hopeful belongs to saving something while accepting a change.
Strawberry-lemon cordial, blended Scotch and soda build a bright, expanding highball. Buoyant evokes the idea that grows beyond its first maker.
Beetroot bourbon, tawny port and clear cacao liqueur arrive in separate layers. Mesmerising comes from seeing how the trick works and still watching it.
Freezer-cold vodka meets a little dry vermouth and freshly grated lemon zest. Magnetic reflects the intense, spare impression of the drink and its quiet reading.
Bourbon, orange liqueur and bitters meet dry champagne over a sugar cube. Mischievous belongs to the sweetness changing the drink as the cube dissolves.
Islay and Irish whiskies meet demerara, lemon peel and hot water. Dazzling evokes the performer's craft; Steamy is the served temperature, not a health claim.
Pungent Batavia arrack meets a sweet-sour Seville-orange shrub and still water. Assured fits a drink assembled to hold its intended balance.
Young grappa meets sweet blanc vermouth scented with fig leaf. Herbal refers to leaf and vermouth, not fig fruit; Intriguing evokes seeing value in an overlooked part.
Cognac and pale dry ginger ale are poured around a long lemon-peel spiral. Gentle reflects the drink's rounded long form and the considerate gesture.
Unpeated Speyside malt gains elderflower beside orange bitters. Unconventional comes from entering on your own terms; Floral is the actual liqueur accent.
Sloe gin and lemon meet dry gin and a small Cynar addition. Daring reflects the willing leap; sweet fruit and bitter seasoning remain both perceptible.
Palm-sap spirit and gin meet sweet vermouth and orange oils. Earthy comes from the named spirit's sourced tasting description; Defiant belongs to the rule challenged.
Armagnac is seasoned with yellow Chartreuse, bitters and a small syrup measure. Uncompromising evokes keeping the thing worth keeping rather than reflexively refusing it.
Aged rum, cola, lime and bitters make a familiar long drink with its bite kept in. Irreverent fits puncturing the shared pretence.
Dry white wine takes bay-leaf scent overnight, then becomes a light spritzer. Liberating evokes choosing your own way; there is no added sugar.
Young grappa is sweetened with Nebbiolo wine syrup and orange bitters. Provocative fits giving the once-dismissed spirit the central place in the drink.
Canadian whisky meets measured maple syrup, a little curaçao and bitters. Loyal reflects knowing where you stand; Rounded comes from the controlled sweetening.
Rye and triple sec meet lemon and perfumed quince paste. Audacious fits recognising and giving form to something before it has a familiar name.
Amaretto brings the almond-like flavour; bourbon, lemon and sherry vinegar balance it under egg-white foam. Contrarian evokes questioning the easy verdict on a sweet bottle.
Espresso and roasted-parsnip syrup are shaken with brandy. Welcoming evokes the open invitation; roast and root flavours give it depth beyond plain coffee.
Liquorice-root syrup draws out a botanical note in juniper-led gin, with aromatic bitters. Unassuming belongs to a familiar-looking drink with a quietly distinctive skill.
Blanco tequila, triple sec and lime make a Margarita, lifted with grapefruit peel. Spirited evokes making your own opening rather than the alcohol's strength alone.
Apple brandy joins rye in a vermouth-and-bitters drink. Gutsy belongs to the willingness to help before knowing the whole job.
Cachaça meets lime pieces, coarse sugar and cracked ice. Carefree evokes enjoying the uncomplicated pleasure of a Caipirinha without dressing it up.
Malört and frozen grapefruit supply a pronounced bitter-tart profile, rounded with maple and salt. Cheeky evokes the willing prank, without promising a gentle drink.
Amber rum and sweet vermouth meet lemon and a soft brandied peach. Affectionate belongs to making time for an ordinary ingredient to become someone's first choice.
Mezcal meets orange marmalade for both sugar and bitter peel. Lovable comes from the unpretentious marmalade-jar gesture; the drink remains spirit-forward.
Gin, lemon and syrup are lengthened with brut champagne. Irresistible evokes the charm of asking successfully for just one exception.
Apple brandy, pomegranate grenadine and measured lime or lemon make a fruit-led sour. Empowering comes from the reading's shared practical knowledge, not an alcohol effect.
Sloe gin and dry gin meet dry vermouth, with the gin split adjusted to the bottle's sweetness. Familiar evokes the remembered advice behind the repeatable recipe.
Cognac and sweet vermouth are scented with mandarin liqueur and peel. Gracious comes from letting the conversation finish before delivering the drink.
Bourbon, lemon and curaçao form a Daisy with a little dry vermouth and soda. Polished reflects the deliberate finish and care offered on another's behalf.
A vodka-and-lemon sour enters a glass coated with dry apricot eau-de-vie. Elegant comes from preserving the old gesture while changing the drink around it.
A lemon-and-bourbon sour sits beneath a float of dry red wine. Noble evokes the place kept for others; the wine gives the fruit at the opening sip.
Dry vermouth and gin meet sweet Tokaji wine and orange bitters. Luscious refers to the wine's rich sweetness; Opulent evokes asking for the version you truly want.
Raspberry-cumin syrup, lime and mint make a vivid vodka drink on crushed ice. Charismatic comes from inviting others into the next small choice.
Fresh pineapple is strained out of a rye-and-vermouth drink but leaves its taste beside bitters. Magnetic reflects attention that remains after the gesture.
Rye and a little rum meet orange juice sharpened with citrus acids. Majestic evokes the long view carried by a substantial, bright sour.
Pimm's keeps strawberry, cucumber and mint, while Peychaud's joins it beside lemon and soda. Rebellious belongs to letting the new idea into an existing structure.
Rye and cognac share a stirred vermouth drink, with cardamom and Bénédictine. Diplomatic evokes bringing both sides in without disguising either spirit.
Blended Scotch is sweetened with a little barley-malt syrup and aromatic bitters. Composed fits hearing the argument through before reaching a decision.
Mint and tarragon are shaken with gin and lemon, then finished with soda. Encouraging belongs to the invitation to discover what the other person now knows.
Popcorn-steeped demerara syrup gives a bourbon Old-Fashioned a toasted grain accent. Ingenious evokes the hidden construction that makes the finished thing work.
Old-style genever keeps its malt character over a small brandy base, with syrup and bitters. Reflective comes from looking behind a neat explanation.
Barrel-proof rye gives the opening Old-Fashioned its presence; the coffee block adds roast as it melts. Contemplative belongs to the drink's unfolding over time.
Pisco, orange liqueur and blanc vermouth meet white verjus. Luminous evokes a clear, precise drink; the grapes' acid supplies its actual tartness.
Raspberry and red-wine syrup deepen a gin sour beneath egg-white froth. Witty fits a soft-looking drink with an adult fruit-and-wine depth.
Scotch, vermouth and two sherries are finished with sage. Nutty describes oloroso's aroma, not a nut ingredient; Discerning reflects its layered sensory attention.
Two different whiskies called rye meet tamarind water, demerara and bitters. Revelatory comes from the change in how the familiar name is understood.
Ruby and tawny port meet strong black tea, which adds a drying edge to sweet wine. Resolute fits holding a carefully examined view; the drink is not labelled dry.
Blanco tequila is lengthened with soda and scented with oregano on the ice. Easygoing evokes letting the plain pleasure stand without joining the argument.
Unpeated Scotch and soda gain a measured touch of vanilla extract. Curious belongs to making one observable change and recording what it does.
